audience: coworking space managers who run desks, rooms and memberships in Nexudus

useCases.title: Review bookings for desks and rooms
useCases.text: List bookings in an updated time window. Open a resource to read all of its fields.

useCases.title: Find a coworker and read the full profile
useCases.text: Search coworkers by full name. Open one coworker to read all of its fields.

useCases.title: Review check-ins at the space
useCases.text: Read your own coworker profiles to see which space your login reaches. List coworker check-ins in an updated time window.

useCases.title: Review invoices issued to coworkers
useCases.text: List coworker invoices, filtered by invoice number or updated time window. Open one invoice to read all of its fields.
